lines.zh: 丛林棘背兽在丛林间穿梭。
lines.en: The Jungle Dramcryx moves through the jungle.

lines.zh: 棘刺摩擦声伴着它的脚步。
lines.en: The sound of thorns scraping accompanies its steps.

lines.zh: 它的棘背在树林间轻轻滑动。
lines.en: Its spiky back glides through the trees.

lines.zh: 它啃食着丛林中的果实。
lines.en: It munches on jungle fruits.

lines.zh: 丛林棘背兽慢慢靠近。
lines.en: The Jungle Dramcryx slowly approaches.

lines.zh: 它警惕地寻找着食物。
lines.en: It cautiously searches for food.

lines.zh: 丛林棘背兽发出低沉的警告声。
lines.en: The Jungle Dramcryx emits a low warning.

lines.zh: 它在寻找下一个目标。
lines.en: It searches for its next target.

lines.zh: 丛林棘背兽踏过落叶。
lines.en: The Jungle Dramcryx steps on fallen leaves.

lines.zh: 它贴着树根爬，棘刺刮过藤蔓。
lines.en: It crawls along the roots, spines scraping the vines.

lines.zh: 丛林棘背兽嗅着树皮找路。
lines.en: The Jungle Dramcryx sniffs the bark to find its way.

lines.zh: 它低身钻过垂下的藤条。
lines.en: It ducks low under the hanging vines.

lines.zh: 它静静地在丛林中徘徊。
lines.en: It quietly wanders through the jungle.

lines.zh: 丛林棘背兽懒洋洋地晒太阳。
lines.en: The Jungle Dramcryx lazily basks in the sun.

lines.zh: 它用触角轻触周围的环境。
lines.en: It gently touches its surroundings with its触角。

lines.zh: 丛林棘背兽静静地站着。
lines.en: The Jungle Dramcryx stands still.

lines.zh: 它注视着丛林中的动静。
lines.en: It watches the jungle for movement.

lines.zh: 丛林棘背兽悠闲地散步。
lines.en: The Jungle Dramcryx strolls leisurely.

lines.zh: 它静静地思考。
lines.en: It thinks quietly.

lines.zh: 丛林棘背兽享受着凉爽的微风。
lines.en: The Jungle Dramcryx enjoys the cool breeze.

lines.zh: 它在丛林中闲逛。
lines.en: It wanders in the jungle.

lines.zh: 它静静地等待着。
lines.en: It waits quietly.

lines.zh: 丛林棘背兽注视着你。
lines.en: The Jungle Dramcryx stares at you.

lines.zh: 背上的棘刺全竖起来了。
lines.en: Every spine on my back stands up.

lines.zh: 它认出了你的气味。
lines.en: It recognizes your scent.

lines.zh: 丛林棘背兽盯着你。
lines.en: The Jungle Dramcryx fixes its gaze on you.

lines.zh: 它向你发出警告。
lines.en: It gives you a warning.

lines.zh: 丛林棘背兽准备攻击。
lines.en: The Jungle Dramcryx prepares to attack.

lines.zh: 它看着你，准备一击。
lines.en: It looks at you, ready to strike.

lines.zh: 它盯着你看了一阵子。
lines.en: It stared at you for a while.

lines.zh: 丛林棘背兽发现了你。
lines.en: The Jungle Dramcryx spots you.

lines.zh: 它凝视着你。
lines.en: It gazes at you.

lines.zh: 锋利的利刺划过我的皮肤。
lines.en: Sharp spines scratch my skin.

lines.zh: 我的皮毛因战斗而受伤。
lines.en: My fur is torn by the fight.

lines.zh: 树叶遮住了我的视线。
lines.en: Leaves block my view.

lines.zh: 丛林荆棘缠住了我的腿。
lines.en: Jungle thorns catch my leg.

lines.zh: 毒藤咬伤了我。
lines.en: Poison ivy bites me.

lines.zh: 树枝击中了我的身体。
lines.en: Branch hits me.

lines.zh: 树叶挡住了我的去路。
lines.en: Leaves block my path.

lines.zh: 藤蔓缠住了我的脖子。
lines.en: Vines choke my neck.

lines.zh: 刺丛划伤了我的背部。
lines.en: Bushes scratch my back.

lines.zh: 丛林中潜伏着危险。
lines.en: Peril lurks in the jungle.

lines.zh: 嘶嘶声中，它盯着你手中的果实。
lines.en: It hisses, eyeing the fruit in your hand.

lines.zh: 丛林碎片闪耀着，吸引着你的注意。
lines.en: Jungle shards glint, drawing your gaze.

lines.zh: 它的棘刺在光线下闪烁，你感到一丝威胁。
lines.en: Its spines gleam in the light, a threat felt.

lines.zh: 它靠近你，仿佛嗅到了猎物的气味。
lines.en: It approaches, snuffling for prey.

lines.zh: 锋利的牙齿轻轻触碰，试探你的反应。
lines.en: Sharp teeth gently touch, testing your response.

lines.zh: 它张开嘴，露出尖锐的牙齿。
lines.en: It opens its mouth, showing sharp teeth.

lines.zh: 棘背上的鳞片在阳光下发出金属般的光泽。
lines.en: Its scales gleam like metal under the sun.

lines.zh: 它的眼中闪烁着渴望的眼神。
lines.en: Its eyes gleam with hunger.

lines.zh: 丛林中回响着它的低吼，挑衅你。
lines.en: Its low growl echoes through the jungle,挑衅你.

lines.zh: 它跃起，试图接近你手中的食物。
lines.en: It leaps, trying to reach your food.

lines.zh: 它的棘背与你碰撞，刺痛你的皮肤。
lines.en: Its spined back collides,刺痛你的皮肤.

lines.zh: 你撞上它的坚硬棘背，感到疼痛。
lines.en: You collide with its tough spine, feeling pain.

lines.zh: 它的身体撞击你，试图将你推开。
lines.en: Its body collides, pushing you away.

lines.zh: 它的碰撞让你感到疼痛，棘背坚硬无比。
lines.en: Its collision hurts, spine impossibly hard.

lines.zh: 你躲避它的攻击，它的棘背撞击你。
lines.en: You dodge its attack, spine collides with you.

lines.zh: 它的攻击力量强大，棘背坚硬如铁。
lines.en: Its attack is powerful, spine like iron.

lines.zh: 它用棘背撞击你，试图阻止你前进。
lines.en: It collides with its spine, trying to stop you.

lines.zh: 你的撞击被它的棘背反弹回来。
lines.en: Your collision bounces off its spine.

lines.zh: 它用棘背撞击你，试图让你退缩。
lines.en: It collides with its spine, trying to intimidate you.

lines.zh: 它的坚硬棘背在你身上留下痕迹。
lines.en: Its hard spine leaves marks on you.

lines.zh: 它寻找伴侣，低吼声中带着渴望。
lines.en: It seeks a mate, growling with desire.

lines.zh: 它的声音中透露出寻找伴侣的渴望。
lines.en: Its voice reveals the desire for a mate.

lines.zh: 它用低吼声呼唤它的伴侣。
lines.en: It calls its mate with a low growl.

lines.zh: 它的叫声中带着寻找伴侣的渴望。
lines.en: Its call is filled with desire for a mate.

lines.zh: 它发出寻找伴侣的声音，回荡在丛林中。
lines.en: It calls for a mate, echoing through the jungle.

lines.zh: 它的声音中透露出强烈的求偶意愿。
lines.en: Its voice shows strong mating intentions.

lines.zh: 它用低吼声寻找它的伴侣。
lines.en: It searches for a mate with a low growl.

lines.zh: 它的声音中带着呼唤伴侣的渴望。
lines.en: Its voice is filled with the desire for a mate.

lines.zh: 它在丛林中寻找伴侣的声音回响。
lines.en: Its call for a mate echoes in the jungle.

lines.zh: 它的声音中透露出迫切的求偶欲望。
lines.en: Its voice shows urgent mating desire.

lines.zh: 发出低沉的咕噜声，似乎在消化果实。
lines.en: Grumbles lowly, as if digesting fruit.

lines.zh: 丛林棘背兽咀嚼着刚吃下的果实。
lines.en: Jungle Dramcryx chews on the fruit it just ate.

lines.zh: 它用粗大的牙齿咬下一片树叶。
lines.en: It bites a leaf with its large teeth.

lines.zh: 丛林棘背兽满意地舔着嘴唇。
lines.en: Jungle Dramcryx licks its lips contentedly.

lines.zh: 啃食了一大块树皮，留下一滩黏液。
lines.en: It chews on a chunk of bark, leaving a sticky mess.

lines.zh: 吞下了一颗小果实，声音嘎吱作响。
lines.en: It gulps down a small fruit with a creaking sound.

lines.zh: 咀嚼着地上的叶子碎片。
lines.en: It chews on leaf scraps on the ground.

lines.zh: 将一颗果实塞进嘴里，发出咯吱声。
lines.en: It pops a fruit into its mouth, making a creaking sound.

lines.zh: 啃着一块树根，发出轻微的咀嚼声。
lines.en: It gnaws on a tree root, making faint chewing sounds.

lines.zh: 用舌头舔了舔刚获得的果实。
lines.en: It licks a fruit it just picked up.

lines.zh: 它用巨大的眼睛盯着你。
lines.en: It stares at you with its huge eyes.

lines.zh: 丛林棘背兽的耳朵竖了起来。
lines.en: Jungle Dramcryx perked its ears up.

lines.zh: 它发出低沉的嘶嘶声，似乎在警告。
lines.en: It hisses lowly, warning you.

lines.zh: 丛林棘背兽的尾巴竖直了。
lines.en: Jungle Dramcryx stands its tail upright.

lines.zh: 它的喉咙发出咕噜声，似乎在寻找猎物。
lines.en: Its throat rumbles, searching for prey.

lines.zh: 丛林棘背兽发出嘶嘶声，眼睛盯着你。
lines.en: Jungle Dramcryx hisses, eyes on you.

lines.zh: 它低吼一声，声音震动着树叶。
lines.en: It growls, shaking the leaves.

lines.zh: 丛林棘背兽发出嘶嘶声，耳朵转向你。
lines.en: Jungle Dramcryx hisses, ears turning towards you.

lines.zh: 它的身体绷紧，似乎在准备攻击。
lines.en: Its body tenses, ready to attack.

lines.zh: 丛林棘背兽瞪大了眼睛，盯着你。
lines.en: Jungle Dramcryx widens its eyes, staring at you.

lines.zh: 它的棘背缓缓竖了起来。
lines.en: Its spiny back slowly rises.

lines.zh: 它踩断一根树枝，停住了。
lines.en: It snaps a twig and freezes.

lines.zh: 它低下头，闻着你的脚印。
lines.en: It lowers its head and sniffs your footprints.

lines.zh: 它绕到树后，换个角度看。
lines.en: It circles behind a tree for a better angle.

lines.zh: 丛林安静下来，它找到了你。
lines.en: The jungle goes quiet. It has found you.

lines.zh: 它的爪子扣进了泥土里。
lines.en: Its claws dig into the soil.

lines.zh: 它用锋利的牙齿瞄准了你。
lines.en: It aims with its sharp teeth.

lines.zh: 丛林棘背兽的眼睛闪烁着红色的光芒。
lines.en: Jungle Dramcryx's eyes glow red.

lines.zh: 它的爪子准备扑向你。
lines.en: Its claws prepare to pounce on you.

lines.zh: 丛林棘背兽的牙齿紧紧对准了你。
lines.en: Jungle Dramcryx's teeth lock onto you.

lines.zh: 它准备用致命一击。
lines.en: It prepares a lethal strike.

lines.zh: 丛林棘背兽的尾巴摆动着，锁定目标。
lines.en: Jungle Dramcryx's tail swings, locking on to you.

lines.zh: 它的喉咙发出嘶嘶声，锁定目标。
lines.en: Its throat hisses, locking on to you.

lines.zh: 丛林棘背兽的眼睛盯紧了你。
lines.en: Jungle Dramcryx's eyes focus on you.

lines.zh: 它用巨大的身体压迫你。
lines.en: It uses its massive body to pin you down.

lines.zh: 丛林棘背兽的爪子收紧，准备攻击。
lines.en: Jungle Dramcryx's claws tighten, ready to attack.

lines.zh: 它压低身子，棘刺朝前。
lines.en: It lowers itself, spines pointed forward.

lines.zh: 它的后腿绷紧，准备扑上来。
lines.en: Its hind legs coil, ready to pounce.

lines.zh: 它盯着你的脚踝，量着距离。
lines.en: It eyes your ankle and measures the distance.

lines.zh: 它的獠牙上挂着绿色的唾液。
lines.en: Green saliva drips from its fangs.

lines.zh: 它换了个方向，绕到你侧面。
lines.en: It shifts and circles to your flank.

lines.zh: 它踩住落叶，压住声响。
lines.en: It steps on the leaves to muffle the sound.

lines.zh: 它嗅着风，确认你的位置。
lines.en: It sniffs the wind to confirm where you are.

lines.zh: 它的棘刺对着你的喉咙。
lines.en: Its spines are lined up with your throat.

lines.zh: 它退半步，再冲得更猛。
lines.en: It backs off half a step to charge harder.

lines.zh: 丛林碎片在它爪下闪着光。
lines.en: Jungle shards glint under its claws.

lines.zh: 丛林棘刺先扎，牙齿跟上。
lines.en: Jungle spines first, then the teeth.

lines.zh: 身体一缩，刺向你的腹部！
lines.en: Compresses, stabbing at your belly!

lines.zh: 用尾巴缠住你，然后咬断！
lines.en: Wraps you with its tail, then bites!

lines.zh: 喷出剧毒，试图腐蚀你的皮肤！
lines.en: Sprays venom, aiming to corrode your skin!

lines.zh: 张开大嘴，向你吐出致命毒液！
lines.en: Opens its mouth, spitting deadly venom!

lines.zh: 用利爪撕裂你的衣服！
lines.en: Rips your clothes with its claws!

lines.zh: 挥动棘背，撞击你的头颅！
lines.en: Swings its spines, smashing your head!

lines.zh: 用毒牙咬碎你的骨头！
lines.en: Bites your bones to pieces with its fangs!

lines.zh: 喷射出剧毒的唾液，侵蚀你的肌肤！
lines.en: Sprays toxic saliva, corroding your skin!

lines.zh: 挥舞着棘背，向你发起攻击！
lines.en: Swings its spines, charging at you!

lines.zh: 它从藤蔓里窜出来咬你！
lines.en: It bursts from the vines and bites you!

lines.zh: 棘刺刮过你的手臂！
lines.en: Its spines rake across your arm!

lines.zh: 它压低身子撞你的膝盖！
lines.en: It drops low and rams your knee!

lines.zh: 毒牙在你皮肤上留下绿痕！
lines.en: Its fangs leave a green stain on your skin!

lines.zh: 它咬着你的袖子往后拖！
lines.en: It bites your sleeve and drags you back!

lines.zh: 它甩头，把你摔在树根上！
lines.en: It whips its head and slams you into the roots!

lines.zh: 它的爪子按住你的肩膀！
lines.en: Its claws clamp onto your shoulder!

lines.zh: 它嘶叫着，又扑了上来！
lines.en: Hissing, it lunges at you again!

lines.zh: 毒液顺着你的衣领流下去！
lines.en: Venom runs down inside your collar!

lines.zh: 它一口咬住了你的护腿！
lines.en: It locks its jaws on your leggings!

lines.zh: 在丛林中悄悄孵化！
lines.en: Hatches in the jungle!

lines.zh: 在潮湿的树叶下缓缓苏醒！
lines.en: Awakens slowly under wet leaves!

lines.zh: 爬出泥潭，寻找猎物！
lines.en: Crawls out of the muck, searching for prey!

lines.zh: 在丛林深处悄悄现身！
lines.en: Appears quietly in the jungle depths!

lines.zh: 从树洞中探出脑袋！
lines.en: Peeks out from a tree hollow!

lines.zh: 在灌木丛中静静等待猎物！
lines.en: Crouches in the bushes, waiting!

lines.zh: 在湿润的沼泽中悄悄移动！
lines.en: Creeps silently in the wet swamp!

lines.zh: 在夜幕下从洞穴中走出！
lines.en: Emerges from a cave at night!

lines.zh: 在丛林边缘寻找猎物！
lines.en: Scans the jungle edge for prey!

lines.zh: 潜伏在丛林中，静待时机！
lines.en: Lurks in the jungle, waiting for an opportunity!

lines.zh: 藤蔓下面，它钻了出来。
lines.en: It pushes out from under the vines.

lines.zh: 树叶一响，它已在眼前。
lines.en: The leaves rustle, and it is already before you.

lines.zh: 火焰烧伤了我的皮肤。
lines.en: Flame burns my skin.

lines.zh: 我从树上摔了下来。
lines.en: I fell from a tree.

lines.zh: 河水淹没了我的身体。
lines.en: River water drowns me.

lines.zh: 爆炸震伤了我的耳朵。
lines.en: Explosion deafens me.

lines.zh: 箭矢贯穿了我的身体。
lines.en: Arrow pierces me.

lines.zh: 魔法之力伤害了我。
lines.en: Magic hurts me.

lines.zh: 丛林里的果子不够我吃。
lines.en: There aren't enough fruits in this jungle for me.

lines.zh: 林冠漏下的雷，偏偏落在我背上。
lines.en: Lightning through the canopy, right onto my back.

lines.zh: 深渊吞噬了我。
lines.en: Void devours me.
